metadata.name: GetInstalmentLoanDetails
metadata.description: This API will fetch you details of loan on the account. Details like loan term, interest rate, EMI amount etc will be returned as response in this API.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: CPMID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for credit plan master applied on account. Allowable Values: 500

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

request_fields.name: LowRate
request_fields.description: Low Rate of CreditPlanMaster (This will contain APR for Deferred plan if this is Deferred Plan). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:29.9900

request_fields.name: HighRate
request_fields.description: High Rate of CreditPlanMaster (This will not have any value if it is a deferred plan) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXExample:29.9900

request_fields.name: BillingTable
request_fields.description: Billing Table ID in which Account to be assign after transfer. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12365 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountID
children.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: CPMID
children.description: Unique identifier for credit plan master applied on account.

children.name: LoanTerm
children.description: Total tenure of loan in months Allowable Values: 10

children.name: NetPrincipal
children.description: Total amount due minus the fees or penalties or charges levied on account.

children.name: InterestRate
children.description: Rate of Interest charged on account for this plan.

children.name: TotalInterestAmount
children.description: Total Interest charged on account in amount.

children.name: EMIAmount
children.description: Amount charged as equal monthly installment.

children.name: DefermentPeriod
children.description: Period in months for which interest will be deferred

children.name: OptionalPymtToAvoidInterest
children.description: Optional Amount to be paid to avoid interest.

children.name: PromoPlanName
children.description: Name of promoplan applied on the account Allowable Values: 20

sample_response.Message: Installment Loan details have been return successfully.
